finding.controller_behavior: When a query timed out, the controller could not request post-query metrics from the blocked oracle process and assigned warmed_peak_rss to final_peak_rss.

supported: The 35 affected cells exceeded the frozen one-second query limit.
The maximum measured incremental memory of 88735744 bytes applies to completed measurements inside the declared common safe rectangle.
The Phase 0 Stop remains binding because a time-limit failure alone is sufficient to stop Phase 1.
not_supported: The 35 timed-out cells remained within the two-GiB per-worker memory limit.
The failed frontier was time-limited rather than memory-limited.
The zero incremental-memory value on the E8 depth-44 timeout was a post-query measurement.

record_policy.independent_correctness_witness: LiE cross-check remains a separate evidentiary category
